full_judgment: 18. On the question of limitation, it may be said that defendant acted malafide althrough and realise excess money without sanction of law as such special bar under section 27 of the Customs Act is not applicable as assessment was made without the authority of law. When the assessment and realisation of excess money is without authority of law, then there is a legal obligation on the part of the Government, to refund the excess amount.
